The Tamil Nadu Rooftop Solar Subsidy Scheme 2026 is a Tamil Nadu Government initiative that aims to make rooftop solar panel installation more affordable for domestic electricity consumers. Approved through Government Order dated 19 September 2026, the scheme provides additional State subsidy alongside the central assistance available under the Pradhan Mantri Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana. The scheme aims to encourage households to adopt solar energy, reduce their electricity expenses, and increase the use of renewable energy across the State.
Eligible households can receive combined central and State financial assistance of up to ₹1 lakh for installing rooftop solar panels. This amount includes the central subsidy under the Pradhan Mantri Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana and the additional subsidy provided by the Tamil Nadu Government. The total assistance depends on the capacity of the installed rooftop solar system and the applicable scheme conditions.
Under the Tamil Nadu Rooftop Solar Subsidy Scheme, the State Government will provide an additional subsidy of ₹5,000 for rooftop solar systems up to 1 kW, ₹10,000 for systems up to 2 kW, and ₹22,000 for systems of 3 kW and above. When combined with the applicable central subsidy, the total assistance can reach ₹35,000 for a 1 kW system, ₹70,000 for a 2 kW system, and ₹1 lakh for systems of 3 kW and above.
The Tamil Nadu Rooftop Solar Subsidy Scheme aims to benefit 1 lakh domestic electricity consumers, with a budget allocation of ₹50 crore for implementation. The State subsidy is additional to the central assistance and is subject to the prescribed installation, commissioning, and verification requirements. Tamil Nadu has previously supported residential solar installations through the Chief Minister's Solar Rooftop Capital Incentive Scheme , reflecting the State's continued focus on promoting rooftop solar energy.
To receive the subsidy under the Tamil Nadu Rooftop Solar Subsidy Scheme, eligible domestic electricity consumers in Tamil Nadu must follow the application process under the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana. Applicants need to register on the official portal, obtain the required feasibility approval, select an eligible vendor, install the rooftop solar system, and complete the prescribed inspection and commissioning process. The Government Order provides for State subsidy support for eligible consumers registered on the PM Surya Ghar portal from 5 August 2026, subject to the applicable conditions.
Consumers can begin the application process through the official PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana portal . After successful installation and verification, eligible beneficiaries can receive the approved State subsidy directly in their bank accounts through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Applicants should follow the official scheme guidelines to confirm their eligibility, complete the required formalities, and receive the applicable rooftop solar subsidy.

The Tamil Nadu Government has not yet notified the final eligibility conditions for the new Rooftop Solar Subsidy Scheme. Based on the available information, the following conditions are tentative and may be revised when the official implementation guidelines are released.
The applicant must be a domestic electricity consumer in Tamil Nadu.
The applicant must have registered on the PM Surya Ghar portal on or after 05.08.2026.
The applicant must have a valid electricity connection and a house with a roof suitable for installing solar panels.
The applicant must not have availed any other subsidy for solar panels.
The system must complete installation, net-metering, commissioning and verification successfully.
The consumer must have received the central subsidy under PM Surya Ghar.
The scheme covers residential rooftop solar systems of up to 10 kW.
Industrial, commercial and other non-domestic electricity consumers.
Consumers who registered on the PM Surya Ghar portal before 05.08.2026.
Consumers whose rooftop solar system has not been commissioned or whose central subsidy has not been credited.
Consumers who apply after the State subsidy reaches the limit of 1 lakh beneficiaries.
The Tamil Nadu Government Order does not specify a separate list of documents for the State rooftop solar subsidy. Eligible domestic consumers must meet the applicable requirements of the Pradhan Mantri Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana and complete the prescribed installation and verification process.
Electricity consumer (service connection) number, as shown on a recent electricity bill.
Bank account details along with a cancelled cheque or bank passbook.
Eligible domestic electricity consumers must follow the process given below to receive the benefits of TN Solar Rooftop Subsidy Scheme.
Visit the official PM Surya Ghar portal and click "Apply Now".
Select Tamil Nadu as your State and Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Limited (TNPDCL) as your electricity distribution company.
Enter your electricity consumer number and mobile number to complete the registration.
Submit the rooftop solar application. The portal generates an application reference number, which you should keep for tracking the central and State subsidy.
Wait for TNPDCL to check technical feasibility and approve your application.
After approval, choose a TEDA-empanelled vendor and get the rooftop solar system installed with DCR-compliant, ALMM-listed solar modules.
Submit the installation details on the portal. TNPDCL then installs the net meter, inspects the system, commissions it and connects it to the grid.
Enter your bank account details and upload a cancelled cheque or bank passbook on the portal.
REC verifies your claim and credits the central subsidy of up to ₹78,000 to your bank account through DBT.
MNRE then shares your details with the Tamil Nadu Government. TEDA verifies your eligibility, commissioning and bank details, and uploads them through IFHRMS.
The State Government credits the state subsidy to your bank account through DBT, within 7–15 days.

1. What is the Tamil Nadu Rooftop Solar Subsidy Scheme?
It is a new state scheme announced in the Revised Budget 2026-27 that gives domestic consumers a subsidy of up to Rs.1 lakh for installing rooftop solar panels, in convergence with the Pradhan Mantri Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana.
2. How much subsidy will I get for a 3 kW rooftop solar system in Tamil Nadu?
You get ₹78,000 from the Centre and ₹22,000 from the State, a total of ₹1 lakh.
3. Do I need to apply separately for the state subsidy?
No. You apply only on the PM Surya Ghar portal. The State subsidy follows automatically after the central subsidy reaches your account.
4. Is this scheme different from the Chief Minister's Solar Rooftop Capital Incentive Scheme?
Yes. The Chief Minister's Solar Rooftop Capital Incentive Scheme was an earlier state scheme run through TEDA, offering Rs.20,000 per kW. It has largely gone out of active use since the Pradhan Mantri Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana was launched, and this new scheme takes its place.
5. Who can benefit from the Tamil Nadu Rooftop Solar Subsidy Scheme?
Domestic electricity consumers in Tamil Nadu who registered on the PM Surya Ghar portal from 05.08.2026 and whose systems have been installed, commissioned and verified are eligible.
6. Will the Tamil Nadu rooftop solar subsidy be available along with PM Surya Ghar subsidy?
Yes. Eligible domestic electricity consumers in Tamil Nadu can receive the State subsidy along with the central subsidy under the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana. The combined financial assistance can reach ₹1 lakh for rooftop solar installation, subject to the applicable eligibility and verification conditions.
7. How much State subsidy is available for 1 kW and 2 kW systems?
The State pays ₹5,000 for systems of up to 1 kW and ₹10,000 for systems of up to 2 kW.
8. Do I need to apply separately for the Tamil Nadu State subsidy?
No. You apply only on the PM Surya Ghar portal. The State subsidy follows automatically after the central subsidy reaches your account.
9. Can I get the State subsidy if I registered on PM Surya Ghar before 05.08.2026?
No. The subsidy will be provided to such consumers who registered on the PM Surya Ghar portal from 05.08.2026.
10. When will I receive the Tamil Nadu State subsidy?
The State releases the subsidy after the central subsidy is credited and TEDA completes verification. The State portal indicates a timeline of 7–15 days.
11. Which vendor should I choose for installation?
Choose a TEDA-empanelled vendor who installs DCR-compliant, ALMM-listed solar modules.
